email.subject: Family Works Dentistry — quick site fix idea
email.body:
Hi Jack,

I looked at the Family Works Dentistry site. Two things are likely costing you new patients: the homepage images are large enough that the page loads slowly on mobile, and the title tag is generic, so you're probably not showing up well when someone in Harbor Falls searches for a dentist. Also noticed the footer still shows an old year/info, which can make visitors second-guess if the practice is active.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee. Happy to walk you through what I found on a free 10-minute call, no pressure either way.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
Northlight Web
